requirements.text: **Minimum Qualifications:** \- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. \- 3\+ years of software development experience, with experience building scalable and reliable backend systems and working knowledge of frontend development. \- Proficiency in one or more backend programming languages, such as Java, Python, Go, or Node.js, and familiarity with modern frontend technologies. \- Experience with API design and development, including REST or GraphQL, microservices architecture, and frontend\-backend integration. \- Experience with testing infrastructure, frameworks, or automated testing systems. \- Basic experience using AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and familiarity with validating AI\-generated code or solutions. \- Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and work effectively across functions. Preferred Qualifications: \- Experience in user growth, E\-commerce, monetization, advertising, or other data\-driven consumer products. \- Experience contributing to technical initiatives from 0 to 1 or scaling existing systems and products. \- Experience building AI agents, agentic workflows, or AI\-powered engineering/product solutions. \- Experience collaborating effectively with globally distributed engineering and cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.
